body: Attraction, taste, and values are intensified and made original; you hold an absolute, uncompromising standard in love and beauty.
business: Strong creative power and a distinctive aesthetic that won't be diluted.
shadow: Perfectionism that blocks real intimacy, refusing anything short of an ideal.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
